scene.summary: Ila stands behind a plank table with a few gutted fish on ice. Down the lane, a smokehouse has its shutters closed this morning. Nobody has said why.
visible_facts: Ila stands behind a plank table with a few gutted fish on ice.
The smokehouse down the lane has its shutters closed this morning.

topics.text: Ila sells whatever fish came in with the morning boats.
